attempts.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Create one high-resolution portrait-card fusion using exactly two inputs. Image1 is the sole authority for clothing, pose, hair, expression, light, and crop. Image2 provides only the mascot identity and anatomy. Transform the human anatomy into a smooth golden-yellow compact near-round mascot head and body, featuring green-ringed black eyes and a mouth that matches the source expression. Preserve the real source hair, specifically the bareheaded nearly bald or receding crown with sparse short grey/brown side hair and real eyebrow hair. Maintain the actual gold/brown thin round wire spectacles. Keep the clean understated upper lip and chin with a serious closed mouth, ensuring no moustache, beard, or cap is added. Retain the dark navy/charcoal open civilian suit with the source-exposed dark inner garment and fastening, the white/pale shirt, and the dark brown/charcoal necktie. Ensure a clearly rounded short U-shaped lower yellow head that immediately meets a raised and broadened existing neckline, creating a very short broad neck transition with minimal throat exposure. Avoid any separate yellow neck shaft, pointed V funnel, pinched collar, neck rolls, floating collar, clipping, or cream belly bib. Preserve the actual open garment and fastening with coherent front and rear collar overlap and contact shadows. Retain the complete tilted dark frame, opaque photographic backing in its actual primary color, and the attached lower-right cream note with faint indistinct upper marks and actual overlap. All solid surfaces must be opaque, with alpha only outside the complete card silhouette. Do not invent any insignia, text, or accessories. Keep fine primary details indistinct and understated. Preserve the original mild primary angle, roll, grey light, and crop.
FINAL EXACT SOURCE REQUIREMENT: BAREHEADED nearly BALD/receding crown with sparse short GREY/BROWN side hair and real eyebrow HAIR, actual GOLD/BROWN thin ROUND WIRE spectacles. Clean understated upper lip/chin and serious CLOSED mouth, no moustache/beard or cap. DARK NAVY/CHARCOAL OPEN civilian suit with source-exposed dark inner garment/fastening, WHITE/PALE shirt and DARK BROWN/CHARCOAL necktie beside note. Preserve original mild primary angle/roll/grey light and crop. No invented hidden waistcoat detail, medal or broad extra accessory.
Retain exact primary head angle, expression, cap shape, real hair and visible clothing/decoration areas. One compact near-round yellow mascot head with a clearly ROUNDED short chin immediately contacting raised broad collar, no V-shaped lower-face funnel or yellow shaft. Preserve actual dark solid cloth and photographic backing opacity. Tiny ambiguous features remain understated; no new badge engraving or decorations hidden behind note. Image1 exact original card; Image2 mascot identity/anatomy only.
Output alpha: genuine transparent RGBA ONLY OUTSIDE the complete original framed portrait silhouette. The photographic BACKING INSIDE the frame is a required OPAQUE surface: preserve its original background color and texture behind the character all the way to the inner frame rim. Never turn the gaps between frame and character into transparent holes or a window. Keep the actual frame angle and rim. Preserve an overlapping paper note, pin or other attachment ONLY when actually visible in this exact source; otherwise do not invent one. Do not invent a new backdrop outside the whole card. Retain source clothing, hair, headgear, lighting and crop at full generated resolution. All originally OPAQUE subject surfaces must remain FULLY OPAQUE (alpha 255): yellow head/body, hair, beard, dark or black clothing, coat lapels, collar, tie, buttons and decorations. Dark cloth is colored material, not transparent background. Never fade garment interiors into semi-transparent patches, holes, white haze or see-through fabric. Keep any genuine source outer-edge alpha falloff only at that actual exterior boundary; preserve actual source transparency rather than making the subject itself translucent.
